onboardingFlow.identityHint: Wonke umuntu wamukelekile. Lokhu kwenza indlela osebenzisa ngayo ifanele wena.
onboardingFlow.photoHint: Khetha isithombe ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukukubona.
onboardingFlow.bioHint: Yini ekwenza wehluke? Umphakathi ufuna ukukwazi.
onboardingFlow.bioPlaceholder: Sitshele ngezinto ozithandayo nalokho othanda ukwabelana ngakho…
onboardingFlow.profileHint: Masilungise iphrofayela yakho ukuze abantu bakuthole.
onboardingFlow.finishHint: Imininingwane yephrofayela yakho izogcinwa ukuze uqedele ukubhalisa emphakathini.
onboardingFlow.registerHint: Isinyathelo sokugcina! Bhalisa ukuze ujoyine umphakathi wakho.
onboardingFlow.invitePlaceholder: Ikhodi yesimemo selungu noma yokungena ye-MVP
onboardingFlow.inviteHint: Ukubhalisa kungesimemo. Uma uvule isixhumanisi sesimemo, ikhodi ivela lapha. Uma kungenjalo, cela ikhodi elungwini elikumemile.
onboardingFlow.name: Igama
onboardingFlow.resumed: Ukubhalisa kuqhubekile. Inqubekelaphambili igcinwe kulesi siphequluli.
onboardingFlow.missing: Gcwalisa ubulili, usuku lokuzalwa ne-Banda yakho ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
onboardingFlow.invalidInvite: Ikhodi yesimemo ayivumelekile noma ayitholakali. Yihlole bese uzama futhi.
onboardingFlow.confirmEmail: I-akhawunti idaliwe! Qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho bese ungena ukuze uqhubeke nokubhalisa. Inqubekelaphambili igcinwe kulesi siphequluli.
onboardingFlow.tourGroupsHint: Dala amaqembu, hlela imicimbi futhi wabelane nabangani bakho.
onboardingFlow.tourStoriesHint: Yabelana ngezikhathi zakho ezinhle kakhulu nomphakathi.
onboardingFlow.residenceHint: Khetha lapho uhlala khona, noma usohambweni noma emsebenzini.
onboardingFlow.atAddress: Ingabe usekhelini ofuna ukulixhumanisa ne-Banda yakho manje?
onboardingFlow.weakSignal: Isignali ibuthakathaka. Zama futhi noma uqinisekise kamuva.
onboardingFlow.locationCaptured: Indawo itholiwe. Ukunemba okubikwe yidivayisi: cishe amamitha angu-{{accuracy}}. Ukuqinisekiswa kwendawo yokuhlala kusalindile.
onboardingFlow.codeHint: Ikhodi ihlonza ikheli. Ilungelo lokulisebenzisa lizohlolwa ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwesitifiketi.
onboardingFlow.confirmLaterHint: Ungaqedela ukubhalisa futhi ubambe iqhaza. Qinisekisa ikheli kamuva kokuthi Iphrofayela → Qinisekisa i-Banda yami.
onboardingFlow.residenceNotice: Ukuba khona kwakho manje akufakazeli ukuhlala. Izinzuzo zendawo zidinga i-Banda eqinisekisiwe; ukuhamba akuyishintshi ngokuzenzakalelayo i-Banda yakho.

calls.waitingDescription: Ucingo lwakho lwamanje luyaqhubeka. Ukuze uphendule lolu cingo, qeda olwamanje.
